 ☐ Settlement

│ MR !1859 (#2286) is now rebased onto supplier-automation, which gained #2284:
│ a stopped invoice under a «Bokfør betaling» rule gets its settlement ticked by
│ default. The settlement books the 2400 line's full amount as paid from the
│ rule's account, for example a 2910 card. With #2286 that line holds the full
│ invoice. For a fully card-prepaid web-shop EHF (prepaid = everything), that is
│ exactly right. For a partly prepaid EHF (2 500, of which 500 is prepaid), it
│ settles 2 500 when only 2 000 is open. Should a prepaid or rounded EHF keep
│ the settlement ticked by default?

❯ 1. Untick it by default (Recommended)
     Same as «Betal»: add prepaidOrRounding to the reasons that keep the
     settlement off. The account is still offered; the accountant ticks it after
     checking the amount. One line plus one test.
  2. Keep it ticked
     Leave #2284's default. Correct for a fully card-prepaid invoice, but
     over-settles a partly prepaid one on one click.
  3. Type something.
